rules.raw_correction: The prompt didn't specify any lines of business, so the lob_desc filter shouldn't be applied.
rules.rule_description: When a query does not explicitly mention or request a specific line of business, no lob_desc (line of business) filter should be applied. The population should remain unrestricted by line of business unless the user's prompt explicitly names one.

structured_value.note: Do not apply any lob_desc filter unless the user's prompt explicitly specifies one or more lines of business. Absence of a line-of-business mention in the prompt means the filter must be omitted entirely — do not default to any LOB subset.
structured_value.description: Controls whether a line-of-business filter is applied: it should only be applied when the user explicitly requests a specific line of business in their prompt.

rules.pattern_match_logic: The correction uses no campaign-specific language ('this campaign', 'this run'). The phrasing 'the prompt didn't specify' implies a general inference rule about how prompts should be interpreted — applicable every time a query is run without an explicit LOB mention.
